items.html: And the six last Sefirot of Assiyah were in the place where the six first [Sefirot] of Yetzirah are now; and the four first [Sefirot] of Assiyah were in the place where the four last [Sefirot] of Beriah are now; and the six last [Sefirot] of Yetzirah were in the place where the six first [Sefirot] of Beriah are now; and the four first [Sefirot] of Yetzirah were in the place where the Nukva of ZA of Atzilut is now, which you already know does not take up but the place of the four last [Sefirot] of ZA, which are his Netzach, Hod, Yesod, Malchut; and she stands opposite them, from their back. Therefore she is called Daled [four], because her place is only in the four aforementioned Sefirot alone.
